jobs.description: 토지소유 kind Gold (root ADR-0361; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-ownership): gold.parcel_ownership from silver.land_ownership, when the Silver lane or the served parcel edition moved past the pins the current Gold recorded. It recomputes only the PNUs of the owner rows the Silver release appended (and of parcels that entered or left the served edition) and merges them; a change of the code change table rebuilds whole (land_ownership_silver_to_gold.WHOLE_TABLE_INPUTS). Its own job because an own-producer kind is never a table of `kinds` (root ADR-0287 §9). by_pnu_serving_bake bakes its commit.
jobs.memory_measured: no memory peak logged 2026-10-18..11-08 (no cap, so no memory accounting); sized as the script foundation-gold-panel-rebuild.service runs (307M measured, 57 runs); Spark runs in its own capped container; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own full build measured in its cut-over's gold step (the operator's copy of this unit, gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-ownership): 1,602 s on 2026-11-05 and 1,501 s on 2026-11-07 for 39,396,906 rows from about 120 million owner rows (gold-kind mode=full 1,571 s and 1,449 s). A new Silver release can change every row, so the first run as its unit is taken as a full build again: about 1.5 times the longest, 2,400 s, inside the 8,100 s share of the 150-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: 토지소유 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0361, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-ownership → publisher build-parcel-ownership-versions): gold.parcel_ownership_versions from the parcel's current owner rows (silver.land_ownership: every row of the newest release that holds the parcel), computed by DuckDB inside the publisher and appended as the keys whose digest changed (a removal marker for a key that left), each commit one version_seq. While the lane serves gold.parcel_ownership it is that table's shadow: it reads the input pins and served edition its foundation-gold-build tag commit recorded, so the takeover verdict (gold-takeover-verdict.sh) compares the two engines over one set of inputs; its first build holds every key. Nothing to do when its inputs, the served parcel edition and its code are the base commit's. A change of the code change table, the served edition or the code rebuilds every PNU; otherwise only the PNUs whose owner rows or served parcels changed. It starts no Spark session, so it queues in the documents pool on its own unit's memory_claim, not in the spark pool. Nothing reads it until the lane's takeover PR names it as the lane's gold_table.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261119T152616Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-nearby (2026-11-19 15:26-15:51Z, every served parcel, 39,861,511 rows committed in 1500 s), systemd's memory peak 7.2G, swap peak 13.5M; the publisher's own peak in its run log 7,733,563,392 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (parcel_nearby_versions_build MEMORY_SHARE) and DuckDB fills it and the page cache, so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak. The run fit: no timeout, 13.5M swap, under MemoryMax

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the first shadow build holds every key, so it reads the served parcel edition's PNUs (39,861,511) and the 123,103,469 owner rows of silver.land_ownership (its 2026-11-10 snapshot summary) and folds them into about 39.7 million documents; the old Spark build of the same rows took 1,571 s and 1,449 s (gold-kind mode=full, 2026-11-05 and 11-07), and the first DuckDB shadow of the same kind path committed 39,861,511 parcel-nearby rows in 1,500 s (2026-11-19). About 1,800 s, inside the 3,240 s share of the 60-minute limit. Later runs rebuild the changed PNUs only.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_ownership (the own-producer ownership kind, root ADR-0361) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-ownership), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9): a change set decides a create-only patch, a reflect-only manifest or a full new generation, exactly as the panel bake does per lane. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2): a slow national parcel re-bake in by_pnu_serving_bake never holds it. Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_ownership_rebuild commits a new snapshot, and at 10:55 as the fallback (root ADR-0171); each run's containers are its own one-offs (tools/semgrep/rules/batch-containers.yml). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the public-auction bake's bound: a scheduled run patches the parcels a twice-yearly release changed, and the lane's whole generation is the operator's cut-over bake (root ADR-0190), not this job's. Two slots so it never runs beside both the panel bake and the public-auction bake: the three at once (14 + 5 + 5 = 24g) would exceed the host budget's 22g job allowance (root ADR-0138).

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own bakes measured in its cut-over's bake step (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh parcel-ownership bake, the same by-pnu-serving-bake.sh): 636 s on 2026-11-05 and 665 s on 2026-11-07 for 39,396,906 documents; the first scheduled bake after the publish may cut a whole generation (no reads.jsonl yet, root ADR-0468 §4), so 1,200 s, inside the 6,210 s share of the 115-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

assets.title: 필지 토지소유 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지의 공유인(소유구분·거주지구분·국가기관구분·소유권변동원인·변동일자·공유인수, 100명까지)과 전체 수, 집합건물 호 소유자는 소유구분별 수만 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0361). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-ownership)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, 필지 패널이 아니라 silver.land_ownership 에서 만든다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다.

assets.title: 필지 토지소유 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: 루트 ADR-0361 의 토지소유 by-PNU 표를 판을 쌓는 표로(루트 ADR-0564 §1·§2): gold.parcel_ownership 의 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더해 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙인다. 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 계산하고 발행기가 추가 커밋으로 붙인다. 레인이 옛 표를 굽는 동안은 그 표의 그림자다(옛 표 빌드 태그의 입력 핀으로 짓는다, 루트 ADR-0564 §6).

assets.title: 필지 토지소유 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_ownership 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/ownership/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0361). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287 9항, ADR-0361): 필지의 현재 소유 행을 서빙 필지판의 PNU에만 문서로 묶는다. Silver 가 덧붙인 행의 PNU와 필지판에 들고 난 PNU만 다시 계산한다.
개편으로 바뀐 코드에 걸린 소유 행을 서빙 필지판의 코드로 읽는다(모든 필지 섹션과 같은 renumbered). 이 표가 바뀌면 종류를 통째로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0361).
필지의 현재 소유 행(가장 새 판의 행 전부)을 서빙 법정동 코드로 다시 매겨 공유인 목록과 호 소유자 소유구분별 수로 접는다(DuckDB, 루트 ADR-0361). 행이 바뀐 PNU 만 다시 짓는다.
서빙 필지판의 PNU 가 문서의 전체 집합이다(루트 ADR-0292). 들고 난 필지만 다시 짓는다.
재편으로 바뀐 코드의 행을 서빙 코드로 읽는다(루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 모든 PNU 를 다시 짓는다.
그림자인 동안 옛 표의 foundation-gold-build 태그 커밋이 적은 입력 핀과 서빙 에디션으로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0564 §6): 옛 표의 데이터가 아니라 그 빌드의 핀을 읽는다.
레인의 넘겨받기 PR 이 종류 줄의 gold_table 을 이 표로 바꾸면(판정 equal 뒤, 루트 ADR-0564 §6) 레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다. 그때까지 아무도 읽지 않는 그림자다.
